13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein said first portion is tubular and said second portion extends outwardly from the first portion__.

14. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __independently of said first connector and said second connector__.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design.

18. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

19. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube.

20. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a __separate__ pressure measuring tube connection.

21. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier __in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube__.

22. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line.

23. (Cancelled)

24. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material.

25. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater.

26. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that [[-3-1758066 HUBER et al.Apple. No. 12/068,901February 16, 2011]] both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

27. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact [[surface]] __element__ is provided within the second portion.

28. (Cancelled)

29. (Currently amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion__.

30. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each contact [[surface]] __element__ is provided within the second portion.

31. (Cancelled)

32. (Withdrawn) A CPAP device comprising: a blower to deliver a supply of pressurized air; electronic control means for controlling the delivery pressure of the blower so as to deliver CPAP therapy to a patient for the treatment of sleep-related problems; and a socket adapted to receive a connector provided to a respiratory gas tube arrangement, the socket being adapted to deliver the supply of pressurized air to the respiratory gas tube arrangement via the connector, wherein the socket includes a power supply adapted to provide electrical power to contact elements on the connector for the provision of power to a heater provided to heat the gas as it is delivered through the respiratory gas tube arrangement.

33. (Withdrawn) A CPAP device, comprising: a blower to generate a supply of pressurized air; a tube provided to the blower; and a sheathing body structured to cover the blower and the tube.

34. (Withdrawn) A CPAP device according to claim 33, wherein the blower is in the form of a cartridge.

35. (Withdrawn) A CPAP device according to claim 33 ,wherein the sheathing body is removably attached to the blower and the tube.

36. (Withdrawn) A CPAP device according to claim 33, wherein the sheathing body is structured to insulate the tube and/or blower.

37. (Withdrawn) A CPAP device according to claim 33, further comprising one or more additional elements coupled to the blower and tube in modular fashion and covered by the sheathing body.

38. (Withdrawn) A CPAP device according to claim 37, wherein the one or more additional elements includes a humidifier, gas analysis module, gas flow sensor, pressure lock, and tube silencer.
